priya: quick a11y review of the left sidebar collapse/expand behavior. Found issues: collapsed nav buttons have no accessible name, aria-expanded not present on toggles, and keyboard users can't focus nested items when collapsed. dan: can you share repro? which screen reader? priya: repro: Chrome+NVDA. Tab to sidebar toggle -> it announces 'button' only. When collapsed, focus still lands on hidden child links sometimes. Also the visual caret is implemented as background image so no accessible indicator. a11y-bot: Automated checks: missing aria-expanded on collapse toggle (FAIL). ` and JS to toggle aria-expanded/aria-hidden and call focus management (restore focus to toggle when collapsed). dan: small detail: when expanding, set focus to first meaningful link or skip focus and let user choose? Which is better? ryan: generally don't move focus on expand unless user explicitly triggered for keyboard; if they used the toggle by keyboard, move focus into the nav (first link) to reduce extra key presses. If expanded programmatically (e.g., responsive resize), don't move focus. Use a data attribute to mark user vs programmatic. marta: we'll also add CSS :focus-visible on links and ensure hidden state uses aria-hidden + inert polyfill to prevent accidental tabbing. Add unit tests to simulate tabbing sequence in both states. a11y-bot: Queued checks: aria-expanded presence, aria-hidden toggling, tabbable-order tests, inert fallback. priya: will open PR with markup, small JS, and axe + keyboard test plan. tagging @marta for implementation. :white_check_mark:
